findings: Diagnostics.recordSelector stores first matched/fallback fields for a name and increments count only on later observations. Success-to-none transition is not reflected in selectorMatches. Source finding, not runtime reproduction.

browserDom finds first pack-matched element that actually scrolls, then document scroller fallback. scanView captures target once; no later target replacement or source generation check. harvestGridTiles default root remains document rather than captured scroll container. Changing-view mixing risk unqualified.

queryAll uses primary-or-first-fallback; queryAllUnion gathers every selector with identity deduplication. browser-grid constructs selector union directly but records mediaLink/thumbnail as primary based on aggregate result, so it does not identify actual fallback usage.

waitForDomQuiet observes whole document and requires at least one mutation before quiet success, with max timer. Dedup scan interface does not use this optional engine observer; its settling remains fixed polling.

Diagnostic collector caps20labels64selector entries, but individual sample string lengths are not bounded here. Issue URL builder truncates serialized JSON at8000characters; output may cease to be valid JSON and URL escaping can expand length. No issue was created.
